definitions.explanation: To wind something back to an earlier position. Originally used for tape and film, now also used figuratively for going back in time or reversing progress in digital contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す。
⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}して⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I rewound the video a little and watched it again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}すこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できたら→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧だろう。
examples.english: If I could turn back time, I would have made a different choice.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す is transitive.

ASPECT (て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧): {巻|ま}き{戻|もど}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the action of rewinding in progress.

USAGE: Originally a physical action (rewinding cassette tapes, film reels), {巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す is now commonly used for digital media and figuratively for turning back time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [tape/video/time]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す (to rewind something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す: to rewind a tape
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す: to turn back time
- ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す: to rewind a video
